title: Knee replacement
description: A knee replacement is an outpatient surgical procedure where your surgeon removes damaged bone and cartilage from your knee and replaces it with artificial components. Knee replacement is performed when arthritis or injury has damaged your knee joint beyond repair, causing pain and limiting your mobility. The surgery takes about 1-2 hours, and you may go home the same day or stay overnight. You'll use crutches or a walker after surgery and begin physical therapy immediately. You can put weight on your new knee right away in most cases. Full recovery typically takes 3-6 months. You'll need to follow activity restrictions for several weeks to protect your new knee. Most patients experience significant pain relief and improved function. This type of procedure can be performed various ways, including partial/unicompartmental and total, and the cost may vary depending on the extent of the procedure.
